llm_response.reason: The website offers extreme leverage (up to 125x) with claims of 'no liquidation risk,' which is unrealistic and commonly used by scam platforms. The domain was registered very recently (August 2025) and uses privacy services to hide ownership details. There is no verifiable company information, business address, or legitimate contact details provided. Content employs psychological tactics promising profit maximization. No evidence of legitimate operation, reviews, or testimonials. These characteristics fit known indicators of a scam cryptocurrency platform.
